reason: A persistent DSH vision plugin that registers an agent tool for analyzing local images or data URIs through a configurable multimodal model, with OCR, screenshot, chart, and general image-description use cases plus a web settings page.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化视觉分析工具，可将本地图片或 data URI 交给可配置的多模态模型进行 OCR、截图、图表和通用图像分析。
summaries.en: A persistent DeepSeek Harness vision tool that sends local images or data URIs to a configurable multimodal model for OCR, screenshot, chart, and general image analysis.

capabilities: Reads local image paths or data URIs supplied to the tool
Sends image data to a configured multimodal model for analysis
Provides a settings interface for model and image-processing options
Injects guidance that can influence when the agent invokes the vision tool
